description: This dataset supports an analysis of U.S. presidential election outcomes and state-level unemployment rates spanning 1976 to 2024. It combines historical election results with FRED unemployment data to examine two research questions: whether rising unemployment increases the likelihood of a state switching its winning party, and whether the relationship between unemployment and partisan lean has strengthened or weakened over time. The fused dataset includes state-level vote shares, partisan scores, election winners, election-year unemployment rates, and unemployment change since the prior election.
title: Unemployment and the Partisan Shift: A State-Level Analysis of U.S. Elections (1976–2024)
